value.rationale: Changing return diffusivity at fixed force is invisible to average completion time, the full work law and target choice, yet strictly changes all convex completion-time risks and yields an exactly work-calibrated variance sensitivity. This is a meaningful robustness/design distinction for physically regularized stochastic reset protocols, not merely a single arbitrary numeric example or repackaged mean identity. The physically fixed-force assumption and lack of noisy-inference results are openly stated.
